d.definition: number of positive divisors of n

d_odd.definition: number of odd positive divisors of n

sigma.definition: sum of positive divisors of n

sigma2.definition: sum of squares of positive divisors of n

sigma_odd.definition: sum of odd positive divisors of n

omega.definition: number of distinct primes dividing n (omega(1)=0)

Omega.definition: number of prime factors of n with multiplicity (Omega(1)=0)

rad.definition: product of distinct primes dividing n (rad(1)=1)

core.definition: squarefree part: n divided by its largest square divisor

carmichael.definition: Carmichael lambda: exponent of the group (Z/nZ)^*; lambda(1)=lambda(2)=1

sopf.definition: sum of distinct primes dividing n (sopf(1)=0)

sopfr.definition: sum of prime factors of n with multiplicity (sopfr(1)=0)

gpf.definition: greatest prime factor of n, gpf(1)=1

lpf.definition: least prime factor of n, lpf(1)=1

usigma.definition: sum of unitary divisors d of n (gcd(d, n/d) = 1)

d_unitary.definition: number of unitary divisors of n = 2^omega(n)

d_square.definition: number of square divisors of n

candidates.statement: sigma(sigma_odd(n)) = sigma_odd(sigma(n))  <=>  n is an odd square
candidates.triviality: short argument expected (sigma(m) odd iff m is a square or twice a square), but the 'only if' for even n is not one step
candidates.oeis_screen: set matches A016754 (odd squares), defined differently: cross match

candidates.statement: if rad(sigma(n)) = sigma(rad(n)) then either n and sigma(n) are both squarefree (A065301) or n = 2^a * p with p an odd prime and a odd, a >= 3
candidates.note: to 1e6 the exceptional solutions have a in {3, 5, 7}; A065301 is always contained (C02b)
candidates.triviality: containment of A065301 is one step; the classification of the other solutions is not
candidates.oeis_screen: set is A065301 plus extras; no identity match for the full set

candidates.statement: A065301 is contained in {n : rad(sigma(n)) = sigma(rad(n))}
candidates.triviality: one step (rad fixes squarefree numbers): kept only as a sanity check, not counted as L1

candidates.statement: if psi(sigma(n)) = sigma(psi(n)) and n is not in A065301, then the 2-adic valuation of n is odd and >= 3
candidates.note: examples 2088 = 2^3*3^2*29, 39688 = 2^3*11^2*41: odd part need not be squarefree
candidates.oeis_screen: set is A065301 plus extras; no identity match

candidates.statement: if core(usigma(n)) = usigma(core(n)) and n is squarefree, then sigma(n) is squarefree (n in A065301)
candidates.triviality: for squarefree n, usigma = sigma and core(n) = n, so this reduces to core(sigma(n)) = sigma(n): one step. NOT L1
candidates.oeis_screen: cross match with A065301 on the squarefree part

candidates.statement: phi(usigma(n)) = n  <=>  n = 1 or n + 1 is a Fermat prime
candidates.oeis_screen: 5 terms only: too short for a meaningful OEIS screen

candidates.statement: usigma(phi(n)) = n  <=>  n = 1 or n is a Fermat prime

candidates.triviality: finiteness follows from d(m) = m^{o(1)}; the exact list needs an explicit bound

candidates.triviality: elementary (phi(p) = p - 1 for the largest prime p of n)

candidates.triviality: L0 only: a definition, not a statement
